Bonjour Micka1

bonne analyse

i saw it many times in the market that price react to the QM lvl as you
mentioned and most of them have a reaction, but depends on the market
situations, they can cause a major reversal or some time just a bounce

So as IF told many time, it's better to close a part of our trade at the first target.

where is first target? usually the nearest FL in the TF you are trading
or even you can chose a LTF FL to be more safe. this will help you to
save some pips and Let the other one runs to your HTF targets. this way
when price come back to you, you will be more relax and have a free
stress trade. if you practice it, you really can't take any trade
without setting first target!

(as you know HTF target can be another FL. after engulfing a FL price
will go to the next FL in the direction of the engulf(need multi time
frame analysis and is not as easy as a piece of cake for me yet ))

you explanations on the chart was really good, nothing especial to add, just a few note on one of your chart

Regards

omidFxt

author: omidfxt
text:
hey micka1

all the question you are asking are really important and deep!

they needs lots of time to be answered(and i'm not really enough experienced to answer all of them
 ) and lots of chart. so i just tried to answer them from my point of
view and know that they are not enough! and beg my pardon if i miss
understand some of your question while answering

about the first target, generally the answer is yes but it really
depends, for example if price engulfed the last FL on approach before
reaching our entry then the first target can be the next one and you can
 get more pips!

and about the origin for the target, it depend again! if origin be far
away it will be better to chose a closer FL for the first target and for
 the final target, yes origin can be a good target depends on the multi
time frame analysis and the engulfed that occurred in the chart

and yes MPLs can be the origin of the move too

Second engulfs can be really great when they happen into free space!
but depends on the situation, sometimes after the second engulfed you
don't have enough space to enter and it's possible that there will not
be a good retrace to enter with, and we have to be careful that second
engulfed haven't reached it's target!

about a FTR that got faked out, if you mean the QM lvl, and MPLs, we
have to always look for them in the FL! there are a lot of QM lvl shapes
 in the chart but the best ones are the ones that occurred in a FL!

about CPAZ, e.g when the last Demand in the CP got engulfed we can
expect that price goes through the CP zone and we have to make sure that
 priced cleared all the pockets of Demands while going up! but most of
the time the CPs aren't perfect, if it's in a proper zone, it we be
really nice to trade it

and the cp in your chart, if we consider the engulf of that FL that you
spotted, that will be a good sign for entering with the retrace

by the way your charts are really artistic
